description: Model compatibility matrix for Copilot asset routing. Defines available models, their capabilities, and fallback behavior. Verified against GitHub Copilot's supported-models reference on 2026-08-17.

capabilityNotes.longContext: The 1M-token context window is available in VS Code and Copilot CLI only. It is a capability of the model, not a separate model tier — most frontier models now carry it.
capabilityNotes.reasoningLevels: Configurable reasoning levels are available in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and Copilot cloud agent. Prefer raising the reasoning level on a mid-tier model over escalating to a more expensive model.
capabilityNotes.modelAvailability: Model availability changes frequently. Re-run `bash .github/eval/checks/model-refs.sh` after any roster change, and re-verify this file against the source of truth each quarter.

models.name: gpt-5.6-sol
models.bestFor: Architecture decisions, complex reasoning over large codebases, long-running agentic work

models.name: gpt-5.6-terra
models.bestFor: The balanced default — everyday interactive and agentic coding, DevOps commands

models.name: gpt-5.6-luna
models.bestFor: High-frequency, low-complexity tasks where cost per request matters most

models.name: gpt-5.4
models.bestFor: Reading large codebases or entire repos without paying flagship rates

models.name: gpt-5.3-codex
models.bestFor: Code-specialised generation and refactoring when an OpenAI model is required

models.name: claude-opus-5
models.bestFor: Security audits, thorough review, nuanced analysis

models.name: claude-opus-4-8
models.bestFor: Fallback for thorough review when Opus 5 is unavailable or capacity-limited

models.name: claude-haiku-4-5
models.bestFor: Inline completions, quick fixes, fast persona agents needing rapid iteration

models.name: gemini-3.7-flash
models.bestFor: Quick analysis of many files simultaneously

models.name: kimi-k3
models.bestFor: Long-context code work when diversifying away from the primary vendors

deprecated.description: Models previously routed to by this repo that GitHub Copilot has retired or scheduled for retirement. Kept here so model-refs.sh failures are self-explaining. These values must NOT appear in any asset frontmatter.

scheduled.note: Remains available to individual subscribers on annual plans.

fallbackPolicy.description: Defines behavior when a configured model is unavailable

gated.description: Workflows with release-gating decisions (eval checks, security scans) must fail if the specified model is unavailable. No silent fallback.
gated.errorMessage: Gated workflow requires model '{model}' which is currently unavailable. Workflow blocked — no fallback permitted.

advisory.description: Advisory workflows (code review, documentation, general chat) may fall back to an alternative model with explicit reporting.
advisory.reportingRequirement: When a fallback occurs, the output must include a notice: 'Note: This response was generated by {fallback_model} because {requested_model} was unavailable.'

slots.description: Named model slots defined in .vscode/settings.json. Maps slot labels to model names for frontmatter references.
